column1: # The spectra JSON waaagh reads (#370): one row per command, jq path and script. CI runs each
# command against the pinned spectra release and fails when a path is missing (dev/spectra-contract.sh).
# A script that starts reading another spectra field adds its row here in the same change.
#   command  spectra's arguments, as the checker runs them. {root} is a scratch directory under the
#            checkout with one idle process working in {root}/wt1, whose pid is {pid}; for `jvm`, a JVM
#            also runs there. Flags may differ from the script's own call (--min-age 0s, so the
#            just-started process counts) as long as the output has the same schema.
#   path     the field, in jq path syntax: .a.b, [] for every element of an array. Every key must be
#            present and every array non-empty, unless marked: key? may be absent (Go omitempty: spectra
#            leaves it out when empty or false, so a live run cannot prove it), []? may be empty or null.
#   script   the script (under skills/orchestrate/scripts) that reads it.
#   null     null-ok when spectra legitimately returns null for the field itself, else -.
